title: Da Vinci Mechanica: Madrid Codex I Systematic Reconstruction
description: Folio-by-folio mechanical reconstruction of Leonardo da Vinci's Madrid Codex I (BNE MS 8937). Establishes six Priority Claims including a flintlock prototype 115 years before Marin le Bourgeoys, a combined clock-and-orrery with lunar gear cascade 1:29.5, and an over-centre toggle-lock doctrine.
